dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures along the mid-dorsal ridge featuring a high-contrast gradient where dark exterior pixels transition into a light-grey ring perimeter, enclosing a dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of localized, high-intensity light-grey clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated on the posterior-lateral flank near the pelvic region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An obtuse triangular formation connecting the centroids of the three most anteriorly situated 'O' rings on the dorsal surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A reticulated or lace-like texture resulting from the partial merging of multiple 'C' shaped annuli along the lateral midline.
